user_query: Quickly characterize this protein: report sequence-derived properties and identify likely function from strong homolog/curated annotation evidence. Clearly distinguish inferred function from experimental evidence.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

function: Prevents the cell division inhibition by proteins MinC and MinD at internal division sites while permitting inhibition at polar sites. This ensures cell division at the proper site by restricting the formation of a division septum at the midpoint of the long axis of the cell.
